task.title: Accept analytics/operations and rollback-capable delivery
task.input: All implementations and the preceding two evidence sets, existing deployment scripts and provenance of reused PRs
task.output: Final build/CI/scheduling/backup-restore drill evidence and a release checklist; no automatic production release
task.accept: 1) Trace real consented visits/GLB/messages through cron aggregation to the dashboard; individually verify metrics across same-day time zones/DST/late events/recomputation/source interruption; actual cleanup without authorization must delete zero records (E-42, E-48, E-56, E-61, E-63, E-64, E-65, E-67, E-81, E-88). 2) In an isolated environment, execute schema-first diff verification, build/start/browser smoke, cron restart and a backup-restore drill, retaining exact commands/results/versions; for each reused recovery PR verify head/checks/provenance/permissions, and without bot approval do not claim it is mergeable; do not automatically merge, deploy or purchase new services (E-20, E-29, E-94).
